title: Keep model-harness-task matrix cells for drill-down
narrative: Taloneth evaluates the same model under multiple harness configurations and must keep every matrix cell so averages cannot hide a catastrophic compatibility failure. Accepts FineEnvs cross-harness matrix practice[^fineenvs-matrix].
implementation: `EvalMatrix` and `EvalMatrixCell` in `mechaharness.eval_matrix` index trials by model, harness fingerprint, and task family, and `aggregate` retains cell drill-down.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/eval_matrix_aggregate.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
